verses.1: And he forsook his servants, the children of Nusana, and they did not walk as their fathers had commanded them, nor did they keep the ordinance of their house; and all that belonged to them they abandoned, and they did not spare the poor, nor the children of the dead, nor the stranger.
verses.2: And they feared the Lord, and they gave their goods to the poor, and they trusted in all that their fathers had trusted in; and they comforted the stranger and the children of the dead in their affliction, and they became to them a father and a mother, and they delivered them from the hand of their oppressors, and they comforted them in all the trouble and sorrow that had befallen them.
verses.3: And they continued to do thus.
verses.4: And after this there came Tsirusaydan, king of the Chaldeans, and he destroyed all their land, and he carried away captive the children of Meqabis, and he destroyed all their people.
verses.5: And he plundered all their goods, and he took them also captive and carried them away into their own land, worshippers of idols, who did not walk in His commandment and in the law of the Lord, but in all evil and fornication and uncleanness and greed and plunder, and they did not remember their God.
verses.6: And they ate every dead thing, and blood, and the flesh of wild beasts, and carrion, and everything that the Lord hates; and they had no law from all the commandments of righteousness that are written in the Law.
verses.7: And they did not know the Lord, that He is their Creator and their Savior, who brought them forth from their mother's womb and sustained them with what was fitting.
verses.8: And they had no law in judgment; they walked in filth and wantonness and fornication and uncleanness, taking the wives of their fathers and the sisters of their mothers; and they did every evil, and they took their sisters and their kinsfolk, and they had no law.
verses.9: And all their way was darkness and gloom and uncleanness and fornication.
verses.10: But the children of Meqabis kept themselves from all their defilement, and they did not eat a dead thing or carrion or any of their uncleanness or the sins of the children of the Chaldeans; for their deeds were evil and many, which are not written in this book, which the children of the Arabians do—sinners and transgressors, hypocrites and defiled ones, full of filth and uncleanness and wantonness.
verses.11: And there was nothing upon them that the Lord their Creator hates.
verses.12: And again they worshipped an idol whose name is Baal Pegor, and they worshipped it and believed in it as God their creator; yet it is deaf and dumb, and it has nothing that sees or hears, for it is a graven thing, the work of the hands of men, which a craftsman cast in silver and gold, the work of the children of men, which has no understanding and no breath.
verses.13: It does not eat, and it does not drink.
verses.14: It does not kill, and it does not give life.
verses.15: It does not plant, and it does not uproot.
verses.16: It does not bind, and it does not loose.
verses.17: It does not lift up, and it does not cast down.
verses.18: It does not become angry, and it does not show favor; but it is only a mockery for the deception of the servants of the people of the Chaldeans.
